chunks: And from a sermon of him (peace be upon him) in which he mentions the virtues of the Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them).

key_terms.أَهْلُ الْبَيْتِ: The People of the House (Ahl al-Bayt)

ai.seo_question: What is the source and subject of this narration regarding the virtues of the Ahl al-Bayt?
ai.summary: In this sermon from *Nahj al-Balagha*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) articulates the unique spiritual authority and divine selection of the Ahl al-Bayt, reinforcing the Shia doctrine of *Ismah* (infallibility) and their role as the rightful successors to the Prophet. This passage serves as a foundational argument for their superiority over the companions, emphasizing that their knowledge and virtue are derived directly from divine appointment rather than mere temporal power.
